title: UserAccountType
description: What is required for when a user creates an acocunt.

id.description: The unique identifier for this type of account.

code.description: The unique identifier for this type of account must be lowercase.

description.description: The description of this account type

org_id.description: The organization that owns this type of account

status.description: The status of this account type in the organization which allows for removal of an account type.

creation_date.description: The date this account was created.

modified_date.description: The date this account was modified.

ekyc_required.description: If ekyc is required in order to create an account

totp_required.description: If a one-time password is required to be setup.

payment_required.description: If the account should have payment information setup.

employer_required.description: If the account should have employer information setup.

expiry_period.description: The default time it takes to expire the account expressed in NOW/DAY+3DAYS

validity_period.description: The time it takes that the user account is available before being expired

id.description: The agreement that is linked to this.

name.description: The name for this agreement at the time of saving

description.description: The description for this agreement at the time of saving

status.description: The status of this agreement at the time of saving.

agreements.description: The agreements a user must have signed in order to have an account. Different accounts can share common agreements. Ordering matters in terms of presentation to a person.

subscriptions.description: The subscriptions this account can have access to.

items.description: The unique ID of the subscriptions available to this account.

permissions.description: The permissions to always grant this specific account type

items.description: The permissions to always grant this client

roles.description: The roles to always grant this specific account type

items.description: The role names that will be expanded to include required permissions
